text:
anna_support: Hey team, customer reported a DPA deletion request that we acknowledged but they're saying data still appears in their Dedicated tenant. need help narrowing scope and timeline. they want proof of deletion and audit logs.

matt_devops: which tenant id? any request payload or headers we can show them?

customer_jones: tenant: td-88b2, request ts: 2024-10-12T16:02:11Z. we called the API DELETE /v1/tenants/td-88b2/data with api-key in header. got 202 accepted.

anna_support: copied the curl we sent to them:
```
curl -X DELETE 
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/tenants/td-88b2/data 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"scope":"all","request_id":"req-20241012-01"}'
```

infra_sam: will check the internal audit stream for that request_id and tenant. quick note: Dedicated tenants sometimes have a delayed purge job if there are active backups or replicated HSM-wrapped keys.

matt_devops: can you confirm whether the deletion flow needs a KMS/HSM unwrap step? if the object metadata still references an HSM-wrapped key, purge may wait for key rotation window.

legal_ella: from a DPA perspective we need to confirm roles: is the customer holding controller status and Redwood acting as processor? also list of subprocessors involved in the flow (kms provider, backup vendor). customer is asking for chain-of-processing evidence.

anna_support: customer insists we provide: 1) timeline of request processing, 2) audit log slice showing the DELETE handling, 3) statement about subprocessors that touched data, and 4) whether keys were rotated or HSM ops blocked purge.

infra_sam: found log entry: 
```
2024-10-12T16:02:11Z INFO tenant=td-88b2 request_id=req-20241012-01 action=delete_data status=queued node=gpu-04
2024-10-12T16:02:13Z INFO tenant=td-88b2 request_id=req-20241012-01 action=delete_data status=purge_started worker=purge-12
2024-10-12T16:02:17Z WARN tenant=td-88b2 request_id=req-20241012-01 action=delete_data key_status=wrapped_by_hsm delay=manual_review
2024-10-12T16:12:04Z INFO tenant=td-88b2 request_id=req-20241012-01 action=delete_data status=completed objects_removed=184
```

infra_sam: seems it completed after manual review at 16:12 UTC; note the key_status warn.

matt_devops: that key_status=wrapped_by_hsm is the indicator. we need KMS team to confirm whether HSM unwrap was successful or if we flagged due to backup retention.

sre_bot: Audit link: https://console.redwood.com/audit/td-88b2?from=2024-10-12T16:00Z&to=2024-10-12T16:20Z (internal-only). logs exported to /s3/redwood-audit/retention-2024/td-88b2/req-20241012-01.json.gz

legal_ella: for the customer DPA file, I'll prepare an attestation: confirm Redwood is processor, we used a third-party KMS (HSM) subprocessor: HSMCo Inc., and backup vendor: VaultStore Ltd. list retention windows and confirm purge timestamp.

customer_jones: can you provide the exported audit JSON and the attestation? we'll need it to satisfy our data protection officer.

anna_support: yes. infra_sam can you share the exported file to the customer S3 bucket or provide a signed download? also include the purge completion timestamp (2024-10-12T16:12:04Z) and number of objects removed.

infra_sam: I will create an evidence bundle and redact internal IPs. plan: share signed link within 24 hrs. also note: if customer wants proof of KMS HSM ops, we need KMS team input and may require an HSM vendor attestation.

matt_devops: repro steps for engineering if needed: 1) call DELETE /v1/tenants/:id/data with valid API key, 2) check purge queue: GET /internal/purge/queue?tenant=:id, 3) tail purge worker logs: kubectl logs -l app=purge-worker -f, 4) check ksm (kms-state-machine) for key wrap status.

anna_support: customer asked about timelines for demonstrating compliance. legal_ella: can you draft the attestation and confirm whether vendor attestation is required or if our logs suffice?

legal_ella: drafting now. provisional answer: our logs + signed export are acceptable for most DPOs, but if the customer demands vendor HSM access logs we may need HSMCo Inc. to provide a limited attestation. I'll escalate to vendor relations.

customer_jones: thanks. one more: did deletion affect backups? they say they still see content in an older backup snapshot.

infra_sam: backups retained per contract: snapshots older than 30d are immutable unless explicit erase request includes backup scope. our purge job removed live objects; backups require a separate erase flow and coordination with VaultStore. I'll include that in the bundle.

anna_support: great. I'll update the support ticket with the purge timestamp, log export path, and next steps for vendor attestations. :thumbsup:

customer_jones: appreciate the fast response.

matt_devops: pinging kms-team for HSM unwrap confirmation @kms-team

sre_bot: Reminder: sensitive export contains personal data. mark as restricted, use secure transfer.

anna_support: noted. closing loop once bundle is shared. :white_check_mark:
